note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1939. Seven divisions were filled by nomination without a contest; Ballygomartin and Ballysillan had no candidates and were expected to be filled by co-option. Seven divisions were filled by nomination; Ballygomartin and Ballysillan had no candidates and were left to co-option.
